finance.avg_discount_rate.definition: Total discount divided by total gross invoiced amount, as a percentage.

finance.rejected_expenses.definition: Sum of Expenses.amount where approval_status = Rejected (excluded from cost and margin).

inventory.low_stock_items.definition: Medicine inventory items with stock_on_hand <= reorder_level.

patients.repeat_visit_rate.definition: Percentage of registered patients who have 2 or more Completed appointments.

finance.approved_margin_pct.definition: (Net revenue minus Approved expenses) divided by net revenue, as a percentage.

patients.repeat_visit_count.definition: Distinct patients with 2 or more Completed appointments.

appointments.completion_rate.definition: Completed appointments as a percentage of resolved appointments (Completed + Cancelled + No Show; Scheduled excluded).

inventory.expiring_90d_items.definition: Medicine inventory items expiring within 90 days of dataset end date 2026-10-31.

inventory.total_value_at_cost.definition: Sum of (stock_on_hand * unit_cost) across medicine inventory items.

appointments.cancellation_rate.definition: Cancelled appointments as a percentage of resolved appointments (Scheduled excluded from denominator).

inventory.duplicate_batch_count.definition: Distinct batch_no values that appear on more than one medicine inventory item.

operations.appointments_per_doctor.definition: Average appointments per active doctor (total appointments / distinct doctors).

finance.total_expenses_all_statuses.definition: Sum of Expenses.amount across Approved, Pending, and Rejected rows (informational total; Rejected is not cost).

finance.revenue_per_completed_appointmen.definition: Invoiced net revenue divided by Completed appointment count.
